name: camofox-browser
description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
one_liner: A browser an AI agent can control that looks like a real human is browsing, so it doesn't get blocked by 'prove you're not a bot' checks.
buyer: A lead-gen or price-monitoring agency that needs to scrape sites at scale without constantly fighting Cloudflare and bot blockers.
business_use_cases: A competitor price-monitoring service for e-commerce brands uses it to reliably scrape rival sites that actively block normal scrapers.
A B2B lead generation agency scrapes public directories and social profiles for prospecting lists without tripping anti-bot defenses.
A market intelligence firm builds automated 'mystery shopper' bots that check availability, pricing, and promotions across many retail sites daily.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as a hosted 'scraping-as-a-service' API and charge per successful page fetch, targeting agencies who don't want to self-host.
Package it into a done-for-you competitor price-tracker dashboard sold directly to e-commerce store owners.

steal_this: Spin up a hosted price-tracking dashboard for a narrow niche (e.g. sneaker resellers or grocery delivery apps) using this as the scraping backbone, and sell weekly reports.
